mapper.insert: INSERT INTO integration.if_request(id,request_id,trace_id,attempt_id,status) VALUES(CAST(#{id} AS uuid),#{requestId},#{traceId},CAST(#{attemptId} AS uuid),'SENDING')
mapper.update: UPDATE integration.if_request SET status=#{status},http_status=#{httpStatus},error_code=#{errorCode},updated_at=now() WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND status='SENDING'
